questions.solution:

• Plants such as ferns also reproduce using spores instead of seeds.

• Pollen tube reaches the egg cell after entering into the ovule through a pore called micropyle. After that a male nucleus fuse with egg cell. This is called fertilisation.
 
 
 
• **Fragmentation**:
 
 
• It is a form of asexual reproduction in which organisms split into fragments and each of these fragments develops into matured or full-grown individuals that are similar to their parents.
 
 
 
• **Regeneration**:
 
 
• It is the process of replacing or restoring damaged or missing cells, tissues, organs to full function.

questions.question: The calendar for the year 2018 is the same for the year:
questions.solution:
**Year**

 
 
 
**Same Calendar for the year**

 
 
 

 
 
Year just after a leap year

2ⁿd year after a leap year

 
 
 
Add 11

 
 
 

 
 
3rd year after a leap year

 
 
 
Add 11

 
 
 

 
 
Leap Year

 
 
 
Add 28

questions.question: Manoj used to spend 33% of his income on food. He got an increment of Rs. 1,000 but did not increase his expenditure on food items. As a result his expenditure on food dropped to 27%. What was his initial income?
questions.solution:
**Given,**

Manoj used to spend his income on food = 33%

He got an increment of = Rs. 1000

After increment in salary, his expenditure on food dropped = 27%

**Formula:**

If any value decreases by x%, then,

Remaining value = (100 – x)/100 × Actual value

If any value increases by x%, then,

Increased value = (100 + x)/100 × Actual value

**Calculation:**

Let salary of Manoj be Rs. x

⇒ Expenditure on food was = x × 33/100 = Rs. 0.33x

New salary of Manoj = (x + 1000)

According to the question

(x + 1000) × (27/100) = 0.33x

 ⇒ 0.27x + 270 = 0.33x

⇒ 0.33x – 0.27x = 270

⇒ 0.06x = 270

⇒x = 270/0.06

⇒x = 4500

∴ Salary of Manoj was Rs. 4500.

questions.question: A bullet, of mass 20 g, is horizontally fired with a velocity 150 ms⁻¹ from a pistol of mass 2.5 kg. What is the recoil velocity of the pistol?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Option 3**__ i.e **__-1.2 ms-1__**.

 
• Mass of bullet, M = 20g = 0.02 kg
 
• Mass of pistol, m = 2.5 kg
 
• Initial velocity of the bullet (u₁) and pistol (u₂) = 0
 
• Final velocity of the bullet, v₁ = 150 ms⁻¹.
 
• Let V be the recoil velocity of the pistol.
 
• The total momentum of the pistol and bullet before the fire is zero. (Since both are at rest i.e u₁ and u₂ is zero)
 
• The total momentum of the pistol and bullet after it is fired is
 
• = (0.02 x 150 ) + (2.5 x V) = (3 + 2.5V) kg ms⁻¹.
 
• Total momentum after the fire = Total momentum before the fire 
 
• 3 + 2.5V = 0
 
• V = -1.2 m/s 
 
• Therefore, the recoil velocity of the pistol is** -1.2 ms⁻¹.**

questions.question: Which of the given reaction is opposite to combination reactions?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Option 1**__ i.e __**Decomposition**__.

__
 
• **Displacement reaction**:

 
 
• In these reactions, an atom/ion present in a compound gets replaced by an atom/ion of another element.
 
• Example:
 
 

FeSO₄ + Zn → ZnSO₄ + Fe

 
• **Combination reaction**:

 
 
• **In these reactions, compounds are formed as a result of the chemical combination of two or more elements**.
 
• Example:
 
 

C + O₂ → CO₂ ;

2Cu + O₂ → 2CuO

 
• **Decomposition reaction**__:

 
 
• **In these reactions, compound either of its own or upon heating decomposes to given two or more components out of which at least one is in the elemental state. **
 
• Example:
 
 

2NaH → Na + H₂​.

 
• **Double displacement creation**:

 
 
• In these reactions, two compounds exchange ions to form two new compounds.
 
• Example:
 
 

Na₂S + 2HCL → 2NaCl + H₂S.

 
• **Precipitation**:

 
 
• It is any form of solid or liquid particles that are released from the atmosphere or clouds in the form of rain, freezing rain, sleet, snow, or hail.

frac{{11}}{{16}} of the residents of a housing society own cars and frac{{20}}{{33}} of the car owners have purchased covered parking space. If 130 of the residents parked in the open, how many residents we there in the society?
questions.solution:
**Given,**

Number of residents of a housing society own cars is = 11/16 of total residents

Number of residents of car owners have purchased covered parking space = 20/33 of the car owners

Number of residents who parked their car in open = 130

**Concept:**

If any fraction decreases by a/b, then,

Remaining value = (1 – a/b) × Actual value

**Calculation:**

Let the total number of residents of a housing society be x

Number of residents who own cars = x × 11/16 = 11x/16

⇒ Number of residents who have covered parking space = (11x/16) × (20/33) = 5x/12

⇒ Number of residents who park their car in open = 11x/16 – 5x/12 = 13x/48

According to the question

13x/48 = 130

x = 130 × (48/13)

x = 480

∴ Number of resident in the society is 480

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

Volume of ratio of two cylinder, V₁ : V₂ = π (r₁)²h₁ : π (r₂)²h₂

 = 2² × 5 : 3² × 3 = 4 × 5 : 9 × 3 = 20 : 27

questions.question: Which of the following numbers will have an irrational square root?
questions.solution:
**Concept:**

Real numbers have two categories rational and irrational. If a square root is not a perfect square, then it is considered an irrational number. These numbers cannot be written as a fraction because the decimal does not end (non-terminating) and does not repeat a pattern (non-repeating).

**Calculation:**

√9216 = √(96 × 96) = 96 (perfect square)

√6561 = √(81 × 81) = 81 (perfect square)

√8192 = 90.509667…… (not perfect square)

√2704 = √(52 × 52) = 52 (perfect square)

∴ 8192 is irrational square root.

questions.question: The measure of each interior angle of a regular octagon is:
questions.solution:
**Formula:**

Each interior angle of a polygon having ‘n’ sides = [(n – 2)/n] × 180°

**Calculation:**

Octagon has 8 sides

Each interior angle of octagon = [(8 – 2)/8] × 180° = (6/8) × 180° = 135°

Tractor can finish the journey in = 8 hrs

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Distance covered by the tractor = 60 × 8 = 480 km

Let new speed of the tractor be x km/hr

According to the question

x = 480/5

⇒ x = 96 km/hr

∴ Speed of the tractor is 96 km/hr.

questions.question: By selling a stool for Rs. 72 a carpenter face a loss of 10%. How much percentage would he gain or lose by selling the stool for Rs. 96?
questions.solution:
**Given,**

Selling price of the stool = Rs. 72

oss percentage on selling stool = 10%

New selling price of the stool = Rs. 96

Formula:

If the Selling price of an article be Rs. x and loss percentage be y%, then

Cost price of the article = x × 100/(100 – y)

Profit = SP – CP

Profit % = (Profit/CP) × 100

Calculation:

SP of the stool = Rs. 72

⇒ CP of the stool = 72 × 100/90 = Rs. 80

New SP of the stool = Rs. 96

⇒ Profit = 96 – 80 = 16

∴ Profit % = (16/80) × 100 = 20%

questions.question: Pipes A, B and C are attached to an empty cistern. The first two can fill the cistern in 7 and 10.5 hours, respectively, whereas the third can drain the cistern, when completely filled, in 6 hours. If all the three pipes are turned on simultaneously when the cistern is half-full, how many hours will be needed to fill the cistern?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47126d7dd9a9b0a16ef0f637bde75a86e78f8906eb5d8b2add0da9b99d4bc346.png] 

**Given,**

Pipe A can fill the empty tank in = 7 hrs

Pipe B can fill the empty tank in = 10.5 hrs

Pipe C can empty the tank in = 6 hrs

**Concept:/Formula:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time taken

**Calculation:**

Total work = 42 unit

If tank half full, then remaining capacity of tank = 42/2 = 21 unit

Efficiency of pipe A = 6 units/hr

Efficiency of pipe B = 4 units/hr

Efficiency of pipe C = (-7) units/hr

⇒ Total efficiency of All three pipe = (6 + 4 – 7) = 3 units/hr

∴ If all three pipes open simultaneously, then the remaining half tank fill in = 21/3 = 7 hrs

questions.question: Sham deposits Rs. X for 2 years at 8% per annum compounded interest annually, which amounts to Rs. 72,900. Then what is the value of ‘X’?
questions.solution:
**Given,**

The sum = Rs. X

Time = 2 years

Rate = 8%

Amount = Rs. 72,900

**Concept:/Formula:**

A = P (1 + r/100)t

Amount = CI + Principal

CI = compound interest, Principal = P, r = rate and t = time.

**Calculation:**

72900 = P (1 + 8/100)²

⇒ 72900 = P × (27/25) × (27/25)

⇒ P = 72900 × (25/27) × (25/27)

⇒ P = 100 × 625

⇒ P = 62,500

∴ The sum is Rs. 62,500.

questions.question: 34 men can do a piece of work in 12 days. How many days will 51 men take to do it?
questions.solution:

34 Men can complete a work in 12 days

**Concept:/Formula:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time taken

⇒ M₁ × D₁ = M₂ × D₂

**Calculation:**

Total work = 34 × 12 = 408 units

Let 51 men compete the whole work in x days

According to the question

51 × x = 408

⇒x = 408/51

⇒x = 8 days

∴ 51 men complete the whole work in 8 days.
